# M2 test evidence

All JSON is generated by disposable automated fixtures, not the user's ATM10 world. The final log and JUnit XML have local user/project paths replaced with placeholders.

- `verification-final.log`: final clean build, all 93 JUnit cases, 14 core and 2 real-FTB GameTests.
- `junit/`: exact 14 JUnit suite reports with zero failures/errors/skips.
- `live-snapshot.json`, `real-server-player-snapshot.json`: preserved M1 sensor regressions; fake-player versus real embedded ServerPlayer advancement semantics.
- `m2-index.json`: actual core index statistics and normalized pickaxe route/tag data.
- `m2-live-plan.json`: real inventory-backed plan, quest absence and graph projection.
- `m2-reload.json`: generation change and plan after real recipe/tag reload.
- `ftb-quests-fixture.json`: actual pinned FTB adapter output for synthetic quest/team fixtures after partial/completed/OR/party tests.

Counts and timings describe these small harnesses, not full ATM10. See VERIFICATION.md for failed experiments, precise scope and remaining playtest limitations. The release includes no test worlds, raw player data files or third-party mod binaries.
- `m2-budget-regression.json`: real vanilla pickaxe remains plannable with 4,000 earlier broad recipes, unchanged global caps and reversed input order.
